# SEO Intelligence Engine

> Self-hosted, evidence-backed SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) intelligence engine for search visibility analysis.

## Project identity

- Repository: https://github.com/subircodz/seo-engine
- Package name: seo-intelligence-engine
- Primary language: Python
- Runtime: Python 3.12+
- Web framework: FastAPI
- License: Apache License 2.0
- Deployment model: self-hosted

## What it does

SEO Intelligence Engine collects site and search data, stores evidence, runs analysis engines, and exposes findings through a web UI, HTTP API, and PDF reports.

### SEO capabilities

- Technical SEO analysis
- Website crawling
- Content-quality analysis
- Site architecture and internal-link analysis
- Keyword and search-ranking collection through configurable providers
- SERP and search-intelligence analysis
- Cannibalization analysis
- Ranking volatility analysis
- Search opportunity analysis
- SERP feature analysis
- Entity analysis
- Country-wise ranking analysis
- Competitor ranking comparison
- Performance signals
- Evidence-backed recommendations

### AEO capabilities

AEO means AI Overview / AI answer visibility. The application supports provider-backed AEO visibility analysis when a compatible provider is configured and suitable input data is available.

### GEO capabilities

GEO means Generative Engine Optimization. The application supports provider/LLM-backed analysis of visibility or representation in generative AI and LLM-backed search experiences when compatible configuration and input data are available.

## Important scope limits

- Core SEO analysis does not require an LLM.
- AEO and GEO analysis are provider-dependent.
- The project does not claim universal coverage of every search engine, AI answer surface, or external data source.
- The repository is not a hosted SaaS service.

## Architecture

Web/API -> site crawler and search providers -> domain analysis engines -> SQLite/PostgreSQL -> web/API/PDF reporting.

The system emphasizes domain separation, replaceable provider protocols, deterministic analysis where applicable, evidence-backed findings, and production fail-closed configuration.

## Intended use

Useful for technical SEO audits, SEO crawler workflows, search-ranking intelligence, competitor SEO research, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) visibility research, Generative Engine Optimization research, entity SEO analysis, site architecture analysis, and evidence-backed optimization recommendations.
